description: Header file defining the GeneralLossAlgorithm class for TCP loss detection in QUIC, implementing loss detection logic based on packet acknowledgments and time thresholds.

classes.name: GeneralLossAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements TCP-style loss detection for QUIC, including handling of retransmission timeouts, loss detection based on packet acknowledgments, and configurable reordering thresholds.

methods.name: DetectLosses
methods.description: Determines which packets are lost based on acknowledgments and timing.

methods.name: GetLossTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout value for early retransmission.

methods.name: SpuriousLossDetected
methods.description: Handles spurious loss detection and adjusts thresholds accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the loss detection algorithm with packet space and parent interface.

methods.name: set_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Sets the reordering threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: set_use_adaptive_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Enables or disables adaptive reordering threshold.

methods.name: enable_adaptive_time_threshold
methods.description: Enables adaptive time threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: disable_packet_threshold_for_runt_packets
methods.description: Disables packet threshold for runt packets.
